none: PAS NLM-6B8C57: Roman Coin: Radiate of Claudius II from a scattered hoard
contea di ritrovamento: North East Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Radiate of Claudius II (268-270), possibly part of a dispersed hoard first reported in October 2019 as NLM-6B8C57; split at edge. Obverse description: Radiate bust right. Obverse inscription: [IMP C]LAVDIVS [AV]G. Reverse description: Pax standing left with transverse ?branch. Reverse inscription: PAX AVG. Diameter: 21.3mm, Weight: 2.03gms, die axis: 12
